reason: Authorization tests are mandatory; AC7 must be verified by reading the service, not the UI
Verify snake_case plural naming, UUIDv7 ids, and that the migration applies from an empty database
Verify no service signature mentions NextRequest/NextResponse and no query sits in a Route Handler
Verify no password, hash, token, or cookie reaches a log line
Actor contract, headerless createUser, cookie-cache prohibition, and D-ROLE-1 hook coverage
Verify a11y basics on the auth forms, "use client" placement, and that only rule-encoding components are tested
AC1-AC17 are the acceptance gate; AC2, AC5, AC7, and AC14-AC16 are the security-critical ones
Load-bearing: disabledPaths ["/sign-up/email"], no session.cookieCache, adminRoles [super_admin, admin], hierarchy hook, headerless createUser skip
